notes.title: 02/05/2023 bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Based on player feedback and suggestions, we have fixed some issues present in the game.

Fixed:

[list]
[*] Improved game crash prevention
[/list]
We found that the main cause of game crashes was due to untimely memory releases, and that opening the menu would load some data each time. We tried various methods but the results were not satisfactory. 
Now, we have added a feature that prompts players with a message in the top-left corner when the game's memory usage is too high, reminding you to save and restart the game.

[list]
[*] Fixed text display errors
[*] Fixed gems not working correctly
[*] Fixed a certain status would never change
[*] Fixed unable to interact with certain NPCs on the assassin route
[*] Fixed the buff-type skills having no actual effects
[/list]

Sony PS4 controllers may not be compatible with this game.

We are working hard to provide a better gaming experience for our players.

Thank you very much.
Hanabi Games

notes.title: 香港地區玩家請注意！
notes.notes:
感謝您的支持！很抱歉因爲我們的工作失誤，港區的價格出現了一些波動，比我們預定價格高出不少。

價格已經調整完畢。以較高價格購買遊戲並且遊玩時間超過2小時的港區玩家可以在下方留言，稍後會有工作人員與您聯繫。
